regions.name: Amazon
regions.quote: It therefore occurs in a number of major river systems including the Amazon and many of its tributaries (rios Negro, Madeira, Xingu, Tapajós, etc.) plus the ríos Tocantins, Orinoco, Parnaíba, Uruguay, Paraná and de la Plata.
